chapterInfo.content:
5
Ɔman no sɛeɛ
1Na wo onipa ba, fa nkrantɛ nnamnnam na fa yɛ oyifoɔ yiwan na fa yi w’atifi ne wo bɔgyesɛ, na fa nsania kari nwi no, na kyɛ mu. 2Nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, fa ogya hye wɔ kuro no mfimfini, berɛ a nkahyɛmu nna no awie duro no, na fa afena bobɔ ho hyia. Na nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nso fa pete mframa mu, na mɛtwe nkrantɛ madi akyire. 3Na fa emu kakraa bi a ne dodoɔ sua kyekyere w’atadeɛ ano. 4Na fa emu bi bio, na to gu ogya mu, fa ogya hye: Ɛno mu na ogya bɛfiri aba Israel fie nyinaa so. 5Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Yei ne Yerusalem, mede no asi amanaman ntam, na nsase atwa ne ho ahyia. 6Na ɔte m’atemmudeɛ atua di abɔnefosɛm sene amanaman no, ne m’ahyɛdeɛ nso, sene nsase a atwa ne ho ahyia no; na wɔapo m’atemmudeɛ, na wɔannante m’ahyɛdeɛ mu: 7Ɛno nti sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ modii asɛmmɔne sene amanaman a wɔatwa mo ho ahyia, na moannante m’ahyɛdeɛ mu, na moayɛ m’atemmudeɛ, na moanyɛ sɛ amanaman a wɔtwa mo ho hyia no atemmudeɛ mpo no, 8ɛno nti, sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Hwɛ, me ne wo anya, na mɛbu wo atɛn, amanaman no anim. 9Na ɛsiane w’akyiwadeɛ nyinaa nti, mɛyɛ wo deɛ menyɛɛ bi da, na merenyɛ ne nsɛsoɔ bio. 10#Deut 28.53-55; Kwa 4.10 Enti wo mu na agyanom bɛdi mma nam, na mma adi wɔn agyanom nam, na mabu wo mu atɛn, na mabɔ wo nkaeɛ nyinaa apete mframa nyinaa ano. 11#Hes 8.6-18 Enti sɛ mete aseɛ yi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie, ampa ara, ɛsiane sɛ wode w’atantanneɛ nyinaa, ne w’akyiwadeɛ nyinaa agu me kronkronbea ho fi nti, me nso mɛpra wo, na m’ani renni wo ho adɔna, na me nso merenhunu mmɔbɔ. 12#Hes 5.2 Wo mu nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako bɛwuwu owuyadeɛ ano, na ɛkɔm bɛdwerɛ wɔn wo mu, na nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako bɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ano atwa wo ho ahyia, na nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nso, mɛbɔ wɔn apete mframa nyinaa mu, na matwe nkrantɛ madi wɔn akyi.
13 # Hes 16.42 Na m’abufuo bɛwie na mama m’anibereɛ adwo wɔn so, na me werɛ akyekye; na sɛ meyɛ m’anibereɛ no so adeɛ wɔn so a, wɔahunu sɛ me, AWURADE, makasa me ninkuntwe mu. 14Na mɛyɛ wo amamfo ne ahohora, amanaman a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia mu, wɔn a wɔtwam nyinaa anim. 15#Yer 24.9 Na wɔbɛyɛ ahohora ne yea, asotwe ne ahodwire ama amanaman a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia no, ɛberɛ a mɛbu wo mu atɛn, abufuo ne anibereɛ ne anibereɛ animka mu no, me AWURADE na maka. 16#Deut 32.23; Hes 4.16 Ɛberɛ nso a mede ɛkɔm agyan bɔne bɛtoto wɔn ama ɔsɛeɛ aba no, deɛ mɛtoto sɛ mede meresɛe mo, na mɛma ɛkɔm adɔɔso mo so, na mabu mo paanoo dua no. 17#Hes 14.21 Na mɛma ɛkɔm ne mmoa bɔne aba mo so, na wɔama woadi mmasugya, na owuyadeɛ ne mogya bɛfa wo mu, na mede nkrantɛ bɛba wo so; me, AWURADE, na maka.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na wo onipa ba, fa nkrantɛ nnamnnam na fa yɛ oyifoɔ yiwan na fa yi w’atifi ne wo bɔgyesɛ, na fa nsania kari nwi no, na kyɛ mu. Nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, fa ogya hye wɔ kuro no mfimfini, berɛ a nkahyɛmu nna no awie duro no, na fa afena bobɔ ho hyia. Na nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nso fa pete mframa mu, na mɛtwe nkrantɛ madi akyire. Na fa emu kakraa bi a ne dodoɔ sua kyekyere w’atadeɛ ano. Na fa emu bi bio, na to gu ogya mu, fa ogya hye: Ɛno mu na ogya bɛfiri aba Israel fie nyinaa so. Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Yei ne Yerusalem, mede no asi amanaman ntam, na nsase atwa ne ho ahyia. Na ɔte m’atemmudeɛ atua di abɔnefosɛm sene amanaman no, ne m’ahyɛdeɛ nso, sene nsase a atwa ne ho ahyia no; na wɔapo m’atemmudeɛ, na wɔannante m’ahyɛdeɛ mu: Ɛno nti sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ modii asɛmmɔne sene amanaman a wɔatwa mo ho ahyia, na moannante m’ahyɛdeɛ mu, na moayɛ m’atemmudeɛ, na moanyɛ sɛ amanaman a wɔtwa mo ho hyia no atemmudeɛ mpo no, ɛno nti, sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Hwɛ, me ne wo anya, na mɛbu wo atɛn, amanaman no anim. Na ɛsiane w’akyiwadeɛ nyinaa nti, mɛyɛ wo deɛ menyɛɛ bi da, na merenyɛ ne nsɛsoɔ bio. Enti wo mu na agyanom bɛdi mma nam, na mma adi wɔn agyanom nam, na mabu wo mu atɛn, na mabɔ wo nkaeɛ nyinaa apete mframa nyinaa ano. Enti sɛ mete aseɛ yi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie, ampa ara, ɛsiane sɛ wode w’atantanneɛ nyinaa, ne w’akyiwadeɛ nyinaa agu me kronkronbea ho fi nti, me nso mɛpra wo, na m’ani renni wo ho adɔna, na me nso merenhunu mmɔbɔ. Wo mu nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako bɛwuwu owuyadeɛ ano, na ɛkɔm bɛdwerɛ wɔn wo mu, na nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako bɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ano atwa wo ho ahyia, na nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nso, mɛbɔ wɔn apete mframa nyinaa mu, na matwe nkrantɛ madi wɔn akyi.
Na m’abufuo bɛwie na mama m’anibereɛ adwo wɔn so, na me werɛ akyekye; na sɛ meyɛ m’anibereɛ no so adeɛ wɔn so a, wɔahunu sɛ me, AWURADE, makasa me ninkuntwe mu. Na mɛyɛ wo amamfo ne ahohora, amanaman a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia mu, wɔn a wɔtwam nyinaa anim. Na wɔbɛyɛ ahohora ne yea, asotwe ne ahodwire ama amanaman a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia no, ɛberɛ a mɛbu wo mu atɛn, abufuo ne anibereɛ ne anibereɛ animka mu no, me AWURADE na maka. Ɛberɛ nso a mede ɛkɔm agyan bɔne bɛtoto wɔn ama ɔsɛeɛ aba no, deɛ mɛtoto sɛ mede meresɛe mo, na mɛma ɛkɔm adɔɔso mo so, na mabu mo paanoo dua no. Na mɛma ɛkɔm ne mmoa bɔne aba mo so, na wɔama woadi mmasugya, na owuyadeɛ ne mogya bɛfa wo mu, na mede nkrantɛ bɛba wo so; me, AWURADE, na maka.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
